title: Why Street Fighter's New Cammy Looks So Familiar
summary:
If Cammy from Street Fighter looks familiar, there is a good reason. The actor playing her in the new 2026 film has already had a busy career in action movies.

Cammy first appeared in Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers in 1993, a follow-up to the 1991 arcade game Street Fighter II. Fans know her by her long blonde braids and her beret. In the game's story, she belongs to a special forces group called Delta Red.

In the 1994 movie, Cammy was played by Australian pop star Kylie Minogue. In director Kitao Sakurai's new 2026 film, she is played by Thai-born Australian actor Mel Jarnson.

Jarnson is no stranger to game-based action films. She played the villain Nitara in the 2021 film Mortal Kombat, her first major film role. She did not return for Mortal Kombat II. Before that, she had small parts in short films and in the Australian shows Harrow and Between Two Worlds.

After Mortal Kombat, more work followed. In 2022, she appeared in the thriller Blacklight, starring Liam Neeson. In 2024, she played a main character in Chuck Russell's remake of Witchboard, which the article says received some good reviews. Early in 2026, she took a co-leading role in Killer Whale, alongside Virginia Gardner.

In the 2026 film, Cammy is a villain working for M. Bison, played by David Dastmalchian, ruler of Shadaloo in the story. She does not have a very large role, partly because the film has so many characters that most appear in smaller storylines or as fighting opponents.

As of the article's writing, Jarnson is also scheduled to appear in the upcoming film Empire City, playing Leda. Cammy may not be her biggest role, but it is one of her most visible.
why_it_matters: Casting shows how actors build careers role by role, and how a familiar game character can look new again when a different actor takes the part.

background_read: Street Fighter is a fighting game in which different fighters face each other in matches.
Cammy is one of its fighters, known for her braids and beret.
A film based on a game turns those game characters into people played by actors, with new stories built around them.
When a film has many characters, each one may get only a small part of the story, which is why a familiar face can still have a smaller role.
